Question 8
?

Some people in a community contracted an unknown virus. The number of people infected by the virus increases at a rate that is proportional to the number of people infected by the virus. What differential equation describes the rate of change of the number of people who contracted the virus, V, at time t?

a
dVdt=k+V,k>0
b
tdVdt=V
c
dVdt=tV
d
dVdt=kV,k>0
e
dVdt=k−V,k>0
